Then version 1 stays "PUBLISHED" and in force

  Scenario: AC9 This story adds no table, column, index or constraint (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the baseline of RWB-P1-E1001-APP is applied
    When the migrations of this story are compared with that baseline
    Then no table, column, index or constraint is added to rwb_source_data
    Then rows of the five tables are written only through the reference load and the endpoints

  Scenario: AC10 An admin operation answers an unauthenticated, unauthorised or unknown call with 401, 403 or 404 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the five admin operations are served on base `/api/recovery/source-data/v1`
    When a caller sends a call with no credentials, a call the caller's role may not make, or a call to a path the API does not provide
    Then the response has status 401 for no credentials, 403 for a role that may not make the call and 404 for a path that is not provided

  Scenario: AC11 A write replayed with the same Idempotency-Key is answered once (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a field or contract write was sent with an Idempotency-Key
    When the same write is sent again with the same Idempotency-Key
    Then the second call returns the answer of the first call
    Then no second version or contract row is written

  Scenario: AC12 A consumed call that fails or does not answer leaves the dictionary unchanged (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a caller consumes one of the five admin operations
    When the call fails or the caller receives no answer
    Then no row of sys_fields, sys_field_version or data_contract is changed by the failed call
